summary: Right lung field, clear and well-aerated on prior, shows increased hazy opacification on current with milder involvement of the left lung.

findings.rationale: Matched by rib and hilar landmarks, the right mid-to-lower lung was dark/aerated with distinct vascular branching on prior; the same zone on current is more opacified with blurred vessel margins. A milder version of this haziness is also seen in the left lung on current. Caveat: slight rotation/positioning differences between exams.
